scope: one DRF refit to pinned semisynthetic source; conditional benchmark robustness only

generator.fit_source: pinned public 500x98 semisynthetic sample; Station1 columns only
generator.observations: generated from same fixed fitted DRF; not physical measurements
generator.fit_save: native model is not serialized; deterministic same-seed refit and sampled-frame digest comparison required

action.units: benchmark variable units; no operational interpretation claimed
action.support_gate: finite, strictly increasing, inside fit-source and generated learner-training marginal range; direct fitted DRF parent inputs checked where available; joint support not guaranteed

learner.model: existing Ridge graph learner: standardized variables, alpha=1.0, existing static mean-response recommendation
learner.graph_unresolved_handling: existing learner receives confirmed directed edges; unresolved pairs are abstentions and omitted
learner.recommendation_tie_break: minimum predicted standardized target loss; then closest to action-grid median; then lower action
learner.graph_free_auxiliary: same observational sample, univariate Ridge X-to-Y association prediction, alpha=1.0; not causal

g0.policies: S0, all 15 nonempty M1-M4 subsets, Canonical Oracle comparator

structural_preflight.purpose: error support, activation, DAG rejection, duplicate/no-op and cost only

estimand.interpretation: positive favors Full Greedy; same action set so population common-optimum term cancels from regret difference
estimand.primary_estimator: bias-corrected squared-mean plug-in: ((mean-target)^2 - sample_variance/n)/scale^2; no truncation
secondary: M4 versus Full Greedy signed loss contrast
estimand.absolute_regret: development descriptive only; sampled minimum is selection-biased and not primary

uncertainty.pilot: report fixed-evaluation-sample G0-seed paired spread separately from action-wise evaluation-row bootstrap Monte Carlo uncertainty; no physical population inference

bootstrap.resampling: resample G0 rows paired; independently resample within each action's 256 evaluation draws; recompute bias-corrected action losses and averaged B=2 paired contrast

uncertainty.training_sample_variation: not estimated in this single-training-sample pilot
uncertainty.generator_fit_variation: not estimated; one deterministic refit DGP only

information_boundary.evaluation_requires: recommendation manifest content hash and contract hash verified before any intervention draw
information_boundary.raw_evaluation_samples: memory only; not written to repository

failure_rules: fail on contract/source hash mismatch, invalid DAG, task mismatch, unsupported or duplicate action, nonfinite or invalid sample, repeated seed, manifest tampering, preexisting evaluator artifact, output schema mismatch, DGP/refit reproducibility failure, or resource cap breach
retain all no-error/no-task-error/no-op/budget-unused G0 rows; no replacement
do not change task, action, target, scale, budget, metrics, policy, seed or estimator after viewing evaluation responses
negative or null policy effects are valid results and do not trigger STOP
